import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/roles?filters%5Busers_only%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
